Make a tiny block-structured synthetic volume

Source: R/block_synthetic.R
make_block_synthetic.Rd

A scikit-learn style make_blobs for neuroimaging demos. Builds a small 2D/3D mask with three spatial bands (left/mid/right) and clearly separated time-series patterns plus mild Gaussian noise. Designed to be fast, deterministic, and visually intuitive in vignettes and tests.

Usage

make_block_synthetic(
  dims = c(12, 12, 1),
  ntime = 80,
  noise = 0.15,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

dims

Integer vector length 3, spatial dimensions. Default c(12,12,1).

ntime

Number of time points. Default 80.

noise

Standard deviation of added Gaussian noise. Default 0.15.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility. Default NULL (no change).

Value

List with components:

vec

NeuroVec 4D volume

mask

NeuroVol mask

truth

Integer ground-truth labels (length = prod(dims))
